answer: Because a fabricated citation fails the dawn check immediately, the shale audit keeps the resolved set and the nebula replay shows exactly which ids were live. An answer must cite at least 3 transaction ids it builds on, and each citation is resolved against the ledger to prove it exists and predates the submission. Copying the same citations across 140 aliases as a result pays the reading cost 140 times, while the duplicate detector still collapses them into one signature. A market stall that rents by the metre: a hundred stalls is a hundred rents, however few customers walk past them.
